dedicated.name: Hayeon's Stillwater Mirror

why_by_stat.Resilience: Reduces incoming Critical Damage 1%-for-1%, helping Hayeon survive Critical Hits more easily.

dedicated.story:
"Don't cry, Hayeon. Here, take mine instead..."

As she wept over the loss of her late mother's keepsake, her older sister gently patted her back and handed over her own bell. This treasure, known as the Stillwater Mirror, would later one day become the anchor that allowed Hayeon to endure the Abyss for so long.

lore: After plummeting to the bottom of the Abyss, Hayeon waited endlessly for her older sister to come and save her. But even as the cold aura of the Abyss ate away at her body and mind, her sister never appeared, and her entire existence began to fade away into the darkness. Then, one day, a demon approached her. The demon taught her a way to survive within the Abyss's depths — by forging a pact with the Archdemon of the Abyss. Desperate to see her sister again, Hayeon accepted the pact. While this freed her from the curse of being consumed by the Abyss and allowed her to journey back to the Surface World again, the Archdemon's powers began to spread like poison through her body.
